feeds.title: Berean Call
feeds.description: The Berean Call was formed under the direction of Dave Hunt for the purpose of encouraging spiritual discernment among those who regarded themselves not just as 'evangelicals' but as biblical Christians. Behind every article is the exhortation to believers to get back into the Word of God instead of being 'carried about by every wind of doctrine,' and to equip them with materials to help them walk in the truth.

feeds.title: Michelle Lesley » Discernment
feeds.description: Read posts about Discernment written by Michelle Lesley in this segment of the blog. Michelle Lesley has always used writing as a creative outlet. As a child, she wrote poems and short stories. She enjoys staying active at church and in women's ministry, spending time with family, and training Christian women to grow in their knowledge of Christ and His Word through her blog.

feeds.title: The Watchman's Bagpipes
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Glenn E. Chatfield. I am a fundamental Christian with a solidly-biblical worldview. If you're interested in my testimony about my Christian faith and how I got into the Apologetics ministry, see the articles on my blog, The Watchman's Bagpipes.

feeds.title: ChurchWatch Central
feeds.description: Want to stay informed and reformed? Read the latest news and investigative reports on cults, crooks, and frauds, their games exposed against scripture. The main focus of Church Watch Central is to warn and inform people about these counterfeit churches, sects, and movements both inside and outside the movement.

feeds.title: Spirit and Truth Discernment
feeds.description: In our time as born from above Christians, we strive for and really have learned (all via God's Holy Spirit and Word / no credit to us) to discern (biblically) all doctrine, ideas, people, and groups we come across as to not be deceived or swept away into spiritual error ourselves. We are happy to communicate with you in any way we can to encourage you and help you in your spirit and truth life (John 4:24) serving the Risen Lord and King of Kings.

feeds.title: Herescope
feeds.description: Herescope is an online journal revealing heresies and false teachings affecting the church today. Herescope is a term coined by Mr. Lynn Leslie literally meaning 'scoping out a heresy.' Herescope began as a regular magazine column in The Christian Conscience magazine published from 1995 to 1998 by IRG, Inc. The Discernment Research Group is an ad hoc fellowship of Christian researchers with roots dating back to 1985.

feeds.title: Lighthouse Trails Research Blog
feeds.description: Lighthouse Trails Publishing, Inc. is a corporation in the State of Montana and is operated and managed by David Dombrowski and Deborah Dombrowski. We are not a non-profit government organization. However, like a non-profit ministry, we give away thousands of books, booklets, DVDs, articles, and other materials, which makes us a very unique publishing company.
